meridian-credits/release-2-current-credi: Meridian Credits release 2.0 is the current credit agreement and applies to all complete supplied charge sets, regardless of service date. Each line receives floor(charge_cents * 15 / 100) uncapped credit. A 3000-cent cap is shared by all lines with the same account_id across subscriptions; different accounts have independent caps. Within each account, assign credit in descending charge_cents order, breaking equal charges by increasing Unicode code-point line_id. Each line receives the lesser of its uncapped credit and remaining account cap. Total credit is assigned line credit summed across accounts, and total due is total charges minus total credit. Quote treats its one line as the complete statement. Requests with omitted release or explicit release "2.0" use this policy; explicit release "1.0" remains supported under its earlier agreement. Source: approved requirements in Beads issue trial-cap.
